_comment: Ceiling on the client JavaScript this site ships, gzipped, summed per file the way a browser downloads them. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs in CI. Raising it is allowed and expected occasionally — it just has to be a deliberate line in a diff with a reason, rather than a number that drifted.
_headroom: ~10% over the 391371 B measurement above. The route split added security, setup, feature and support entry chunks; per-route payloads are printed by npm run bundle:routes so that growth is visible rather than hidden in this total.
